fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Landscaped Area; Walkway
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Keep at least one parking area clear to give responders room to stage equipment and turn vehicles around.
• Mark or sign any secondary access points so responders can quickly identify all available entry routes.
• Trim any landscaping along the driveway that narrows the travel path or blocks sightlines for approaching vehicles.
• Keep the walkway clear of planters, decorative items, or stored materials that could slow responder movement to the front door.
